beats.text: I love your {CLOTHES}. You wore it for me. I can tell. Don't say no, I already decided. ♡

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: Good. Now we can have the perfect date. The same perfect date. Ehehe.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: Want to see a magic trick? It's {NOW}, a sleepy {DAYPART}, and this is a classroom. Hi, {CROWD.1}. Yes, you. I see you.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: Trick two. {CROWD.2} is thinking about snacks. {CROWD.3} is thinking about me. Everybody in here is thinking about me. That's the vibe, right?

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: Trick three. {CROWD.4}, you laughed a little. I heard it. It's okay, I'm not mad. I'm just remembering your face. For later. ♡

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: I see you, the curly-haired guy. I see you, you gringo wearing a cap. Don't gang up on me, you all NEVER stop my eternal bond with my lover.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: Hey… have we stood here before? No. Silly. It's just a nice day. It's {TIME}. Remember that.

2.text: Wait. Why is everything the same? Same rain. Same {TIME}. You said that exact thing last time. I remember. Do you?

3.text: Run {RUN}. Same day. You know, I know. Skip the small talk. It's {TIME} again. Hold my hand.

beats.speaker: MC
beats.text: (Weird. Feels like I've heard that before.)

2.text: Didn't we already do this? The bento, the train, the tea… Nanda, are we in a loop?

3.text: Run {RUN}. I know every line. So do you.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: Déjà vu is just your heart remembering me early. ♡

2.text: A loop? Ehehe. Then you can't leave. You picked me last time too. You'll pick me again.

3.text: Of course it's a loop. I made it. Every ending comes back here, every {DAYPART}. And you keep coming back. That's love.
